ENSURING EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITIES TO THE DIFFERENTLY 
ABLED PERSONS THROUGH RESERVATION 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
As per RPWD act 4% reservation is ensured by providing 
job opportunities from gov and public sector 
2. 
Eligibility Criteria 
Differently abled person with requisite qualification and 
experience in identified categories of post. 
 
3. 
Whether the prescribed 
application form is 
available 
No 
4. 
Certificates to be 
furnished 
Qualification certificate , Disability certificate 
5. 
Officer to whom the 
application is to be 
submitted 
Not applicable 
6. 
Grievances if any to be 
addressed to 
Assistant Director (Placement 
O/o. The Commissionerate for the Welfare of Differently 
abled
